zh-CN.title: 投稿回合幕布
items: 当前投稿回合现在使用连续幕布与历史内容区分，不再为每条消息重复添加边框
幕布会清晰提示当前内容仅本方可见，并说明交接后的同步方式

en.title: Submission round curtain
items: The active submission round now appears in one continuous curtain instead of outlining every message
The curtain clearly marks private in-progress content and explains when it will sync
